Appearance:

Shri Prasanna Prasad - Advocate for respondent/SPE,

Order 
1] This is the first application under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023/section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 filed by the applicant, who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.490/2015 registered at Police Station Special Police Establishment, Lokayukt Office, Ujjain, District Ujjain (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 13(1)(d) read with Sections 13(2) & 15 of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 and also under Sections 420 & 120-B of Indian Penal Code, 1860.

entities.text: Police Station Special Police Establishment, Lokayukt Office, Ujjain
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2] The applicant did not appear before the trial court, despite issuance of several summons, as observed by the trial court in the impugned order, and all other accused persons have already appeared before the trial Court either at the time of filing of the charge sheet, or immediately thereafter.
3] The applicant is also directed to surrender before the trial Court and the trial Court shall consider his bail application on the same day.
4] Withe the aforesaid direction and observation, the present miscellaneous criminal case stands disposed of .
